title: WARRANT check
description: Check — a deterministic executable verification that produces evidence (06 section 2). A check MUST NOT use an LLM, so level L2 is rejected.

id.description: Check id, unique across the packs enabled in a project.

overrides.description: Pack object this local check replaces, as `<pack>:<id>` (08 section 4).

description.description: What this check verifies, in one sentence.

level.description: Verification level: L0 (structural) or L1 (executable). L2 belongs to skills, not checks.

command.description: Argv of the full run. Placeholders: `{out}` (the run output directory) and `{change}` (the Change id); any other `{name}` is rejected.

items.description: One argv element; `{name}` tokens other than `{out}` and `{change}` are not allowed.

scoped_command.description: Argv of a run narrowed to `--paths` (ADR-0017). Placeholders: `{out}`, `{change}` and `{paths}` (expanded into one argv element per path); any other `{name}` is rejected.

items.description: One argv element; `{name}` tokens other than `{out}`, `{change}` and `{paths}` are not allowed.

execution.description: How the check may be run (06 section 2 "Execution", ADR-0017).

exclusive.description: Run under the one per-machine check lock shared by processes and worktrees; default false.

timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds; default `defaults.check_timeout_s` of the project config, else 1800.

local.description: Where the check may run: `allowed` (default), `scoped-only` (locally only with `--paths`) or `ci-only`.

guard_prefixes.description: Command prefixes by which `warrant guard` recognises a direct run of this check; default the first tokens of `run.command`.

items.description: One prefix as a list of argv tokens.

parser.description: Name of the parser turning the command output into evidence, for example `junit`.
